programme.desc: Quando uma companhia de teatro realiza sua troca anual de presentes de amigo secreto, o novo funcionário Glenn recebe Lila, a diretora do teatro, que ele costumava provocar incansavelmente no ensino médio.

programme.title: Amor Surreal
programme.desc: Um homem se apaixona por uma mulher que tem um namorado imaginário.

programme.title: AimportânciaDeSerMike_Eps_1-5
programme.desc: Ali tem um sonho em que se casa com um rapaz chamado Mike e começa sua jornada para encontrá-lo.

programme.title: 12 Dias de Presentes
programme.desc: Depois de ganhar um prêmio de US$ 50 mil, um homem decide retribuir a boa sorte distribuindo presentes de Natal a desconhecidos, usando o pseudônimo “Duende Sortudo”. O gesto generoso acaba trazendo surpresas inesperadas para sua própria vida.

programme.title: Um Natal Anos 90
programme.desc: Enquanto comemora sozinha sua promoção na véspera de Natal, uma advogada workaholic embarca em uma misteriosa corrida de aplicativo e acaba transportada de volta para 1999. Agora, ela terá a chance de reviver o passado e talvez encontrar um novo caminho para o futuro.

programme.title: Um Natal Mascarado
programme.desc: Confundida com sua chefe por um empresário durante um baile de máscaras, ela decide manter o disfarce até o Natal para conquistá-lo como cliente. Mas, quando as verdadeiras intenções dele vêm à tona, os dois percebem que pode ser amor.

programme.title: Natal en Holly Lane
programme.desc: Sarah, Riley e Cat, três amigas de infância que guardam boas lembranças dos Natais na casa de Sarah, se reencontram na vida adulta para salvar o lar onde viveram tantos momentos especiais e garantir que possam celebrar muitos outros Natais juntas.

programme.title: De Repente Amor Acontece
programme.desc: Sadie decide passar o Natal em sua cidade natal quando descobre que seus pais estão planejando vender a loja de chocolate tradicional de sua pequena cidade e colocar em risco os sonhos de sua infância de herdá-la.

programme.title: De Repente Amor Acontece
programme.desc: Sadie decide passar o Natal em sua cidade natal quando descobre que seus pais estão planejando vender a loja de chocolate tradicional de sua pequena cidade e colocar em risco os sonhos de sua infância de herdá-la.

programme.title: Um Burro Muito Esperto
programme.desc: Uma adolescente mimada cuida de uma jovem mula e descobre o que está faltando em sua vida agitada.

programme.title: Enfrentando Corredeiras
programme.desc: Uma família faz uma viagem de rafting em um rio enquanto processa uma grande perda. Ao longo do caminho, eles encontram um filhote de lobo. Quando algumas pessoas inescrupulosas também avistam o lobo e conspiram para roubá-lo e vendê-lo, a família e os guias lutam para proteger o filhote. Será que a jornada deles para entregar o lobo em segurança aos oficiais da vida selvagem pode ser a coisa certa para guiá-los à cura?

programme.title: Uma Segunda Chance
programme.desc: Uma adolescente de Malibu se apaixona por uma aventura selvagem de mustang, e pelo pai que ela nunca conheceu.

programme.title: Cantando com Os Anjos
programme.desc: Aubrey reflete sobre suas experiências como membro do Coro do Tabernáculo na Praça do Templo.

programme.title: Amor no Tahiti
programme.desc: Quando uma mergulhadora devolve um anel de classe que encontrou nas águas do Taiti ao seu dono, um militar da Marinha dos EUA, ela percebe que o que mais lhe falta na vida é um tesouro do coração.

programme.title: A Língua do Amor
programme.desc: Julie Walters, uma estudante de doutorado em linguística, fala quase todos as idiomas imagináveis. Ela acredita piamente que as idiomas são mais bem aprendidas por meio de atividades divertidas. As coisas viram de cabeça para baixo para Julie quando um funcionário de um museu entra em contato com ela para pedir aulas de francês.

programme.title: Austentação
programme.desc: Lizzie fica entusiasmada quando ela consegue um novo cliente imobiliário, mas acaba sendo Collin, que não é tão sutil com seu interesse como ele pensa. Elinor inesperadamente recebe uma promoção, mas antes de poder comemorar, ela aprende que a promoção a torna a encarregada de lidar com o IRS quando a empresa de seu empregador está sob investigação. O agente do IRS com quem ela lida é Edward Ferrars, e uma agradável surpresa do típico agente do IRS que ela esperava. Emma e seu colega de trabalho, Sr. Darcy, têm que trabalhar juntos em um caso. Emma acha que seus métodos legais são diferentes dos de Darcy, e a frustração se segue até que ambos possam parar para entender a perspectiva do outro.

programme.title: Austentação
programme.desc: Lizzie trata de coordenar o guarda-roupa de sua família para um retrato de família, com constante resistência às suas idéias e sugestões de impressões de animais selvagens de sua mãe. Marianne consegue um emprego na Yum Divine (uma espécie de bistrô de sobremesa), mas repetidamente se desentende a ponto de ter seu novo emprego no bloco de corte. Através da insistência de Elinor, e da ajuda de todos, Marianne se agarra ao seu trabalho - quase sempre. Grant descobre que o amor de Emma por fazer casamentos vem como uma terapia para todos os casos de divórcio que ela trata. Ele reconta todas as terríveis datas em que Emma o enviou. Lizzie descobre que Grant pode simplesmente amar Ema.

programme.title: Austentação
programme.desc: A Emma establece um encontro romantico para Lizzie que vai bem, até que a Lizzie se pergunta por que a cara não volta a ligar. Sua constante análise da data leva a uma noite de detalhes minuciosos, até que Grant lança luz sobre um ponto de vista mais realista. Elinor encontra um rato em seu apartamento e pega em armas para erradicar a peste - apenas para descobrir o esconderijo de lixo secreto de Marianne que tem alimentado o rato.

programme.title: Dançando no Natal
programme.desc: Ao comprar uma árvore de Natal, Olivia se depara com Michael, que a ajuda na loja. Ele descobre que Olivia dá aulas de balé para sua adorada filha, Lily. Eles criam um vínculo instantâneo e concordam em sair juntos.

programme.title: Eu Vou te Amar além de Tudo
programme.desc: April Monroe é uma médica superstar em um grande hospital de Nova York que se apaixonou perdidamente pelo charmoso veterinário Jesse, e o relacionamento deles parece estar no caminho certo, exceto por uma coisa: Jesse é completamente reservado em relação à sua família Amish.

programme.title: A Bela e o Bilionário em Bali
programme.desc: A médica americana Ivy Miller vive em Bali e trabalha em uma clínica de caridade. Quando um benfeitor bilionário chamado Dylan Donnelly chega, Ivy não fica nada impressionada. Ele só está interessado em fazer boa figura ao parecer caridoso. Ivy fica feliz quando ele vai embora, mas um acidente fere um dos conselheiros de confiança de Dylan, Blake. Dylan insiste que Ivy fique na luxuosa propriedade de Dylan em Bali para cuidar de Blake até que ele se recupere.

programme.title: Austentação
programme.desc: Elinor avidamente vai com Edward Ferrars, o agente do IRS, a uma auditoria. No caminho, o carro da Elinor tem problemas. Ela e Edward voltam a pé para encontrar ajuda, e têm tempo para se conhecerem melhor. Collin tenta uma nova abordagem com Lizzie, decidindo ser ousado, mas realmente só se mete no caminho de Lizzie. Lizzie também tem que fazer malabarismos com as inúmeras ligações de Darcy a qualquer hora para sua caça em casa. Ela se encontra com ele e descobre mais alguns detalhes vagos sobre a pretendida moradora da casa (uma mulher misteriosa), e que é um presente de aniversário - que Lizzie tem um mês para encontrar.

programme.title: Natal Encantador
programme.desc: No Natal, a filha de um escultor de gelo deseja que a princesa de gelo que ele esculpiu ganhe vida. Quando seu desejo se realiza, Jade, a princesa de gelo, deve convencer seu escultor a aceitá-la ou voltará a se transformar em gelo.

programme.title: A Cura de Natal
programme.desc: Uma médica volta para casa no Natal e descobre que seu pai decidiu se aposentar. Ao reencontrar seu amor dos tempos de escola, ela começa a se perguntar se deve ficar na cidade e assumir o consultório do pai.

programme.title: Um Amor de Conto de Fadas
programme.desc: Uma gerente de vendas de Nova York viaja às remotas Terras Altas da Escócia no Natal para comprar um perfume de edição limitada de um elegante conde, que se prepara para seu baile anual. Mas, em vez de sair com o perfume, ela acaba encontrando o amor.

programme.title: Sharknado 4: Corra para o 4º
programme.desc: Cinco anos após a onda de sharknados que assolou a costa leste, nossos heróis vivem uma vida tranquila no meio do país - o mais longe possível dos tubarões. Mas quando um estranho sharknado de areia atinge Las Vegas, Fin é jogado de volta à ação, lutando contra sharknados em uma corrida cross-country para salvar sua família e o mundo - como toda a humanidade já deveria saber, não há como escapar..

programme.title: All American Bikini Car Wash
programme.desc: Para evitar ser reprovado, um universitário empreendedor concorda em dirigir o lava-jato do seu professor em Las Vegas, mas as coisas enlouquecem quando ele decide contratar lindas garotas de biquíni.

programme.title: O Diário de Tati
programme.desc: A adolescente Tati conta, de forma divertida, todos os problemas de sua juventude ao seu diário. Desde ficar em recuperação em matemática até os esforços para conseguir fisgar Zeca, sua paixão atual.

programme.title: Forasteiros Malditos
programme.desc: Após a morte de sua mãe adotiva, um açougueiro tímido e sua irmã gêmea deixam o Reino Unido e vão para a cidade australiana de Two Heads Creeks em busca de sua mãe biológica. No entanto, os habitantes aparentemente tolerantes de sua cidade natal escondem um segredo sombrio que envolve não apenas a mãe dos irmãos, mas toda a cidade.

programme.title: Receitas do Amor
programme.desc: Depois de uma crítica negativa e uma palestra do chef Gordon Ramsay, um talentoso mas angustiado chef londrino transforma um pub country em um restaurante gourmet.

programme.title: Plus One at an Amish Wedding
programme.desc: A médica em ascensão April tem a vida perfeita. Ela trabalha em um hospital prestigiado em Nova York e acabou de conhecer um veterinário bonito chamado Jesse. Entre eles, tudo vai muito bem. Eles combinam em tudo, exceto pelo fato de Jesse ser um pouco reservado quando o assunto é a família.

programme.title: O Que Fazer?
programme.desc: Henry Hartmann acorda com uma dor de cabeça tremenda e recebe a notícia de que tem apenas 90 minutos de vida.

programme.title: Encontro Selvagem
programme.desc: Les Moore é um homem de negócios que um ano atrás teve um encontro inesperado após alguns drinks em Albuquerque, Novo México. Desde então o fato fica revirando em sua cabeça, até que ele decide voltar ao local junto com Natalie Hamilton, sua colega de trabalho, para desvendar o que realmente aconteceu naquela noite.

programme.title: Sharknado 3: Oh, Não!
programme.desc: Quando uma massa de Sharknados ameaça a Costa Leste dos Estados Unidos, o herói Fin, empunhando uma motosserra, deve novamente arriscar sua vida para salvar seus filhos nas férias de primavera. Mas enquanto ele luta para chegar ao sul, os sharknados se fundem e ficam maiores do que nunca.

programme.title: O Ataque do Tubarão de 6 Cabeças
programme.desc: Os participantes de um campo de terapia matrimonial em uma ilha remota enfrentam uma luta pela sobrevivência quando um tubarão de seis cabeças emerge das profundezas, aterrorizando a praia e forçando-os a enfrentar a monstruosa ameaça de frente.

programme.title: Atrapada En Guantánamo
programme.desc: Uma jovem americana se alista no exército com a intenção de lutar no Iraque e escapar de sua cidade natal. No entanto, ela acaba designada como guarda no campo de detenção da Baía de Guantánamo, bem longe dos combates. Cercada por jihadistas hostis e colegas agressivos, ela inicia uma amizade incomum com um dos detentos.

programme.title: Aliança Mortal
programme.desc: En lo profundo de un bosque en la frontera entre Estados Unidos y Canadá, dos enemigos deben trabajar juntos para escapar de un despiadado cártel de la droga empeñado en recuperar un cargamento de droga que desapareció allí.

programme.title: Lobo Guerreiro 2
programme.desc: Com sua carreira chegando ao fim, o agente das forças especiais mais mortal da China leva uma vida tranquila no mar. Mas quando cruza o caminho de um bando de mercenários sádicos, ele deve reafirmar seu dever como soldado e salvar o dia mais uma vez. A partir daí, os punhos (e as balas, os tanques, os mísseis e muito mais) voarão em cenas de ação cheias de adrenalina.

programme.title: Profissão de Risco
programme.desc: Jack é contratado por Dragna, um chefão do crime, para realizar uma tarefa aparentemente inocente: ele deve levar uma mala para um motel em Nova Orleans e esperar que ela seja recolhida. Mas Jack nunca conseguirá abrir a mala. Mas, no momento em que ele entra no motel, sua vida está em risco. Vários criminosos tentam tirar a bolsa dele e Jack precisa defendê-la se quiser viver.

programme.title: Máscara Negra
programme.desc: O sobrevivente de um projeto para criar super soldados deve lutar contra seus ex-companheiros como um herói mascarado.

programme.title: Soldado De La Noche
programme.desc: Um grupo de caçadores de recompensas é forçado a passar a noite em um motel no deserto mexicano. Lá, eles enfrentarão uma horda de violentos corredores fronteiriços e descobrirão que sua protegida, uma mulher chinesa, é muito mais do que aparenta.

programme.title: Esquadrão de Elite
programme.desc: Num futuro próximo, o aquecimento global dizima as plantações da terra e o commodity mais precioso passa a ser a comida. Nesse contexto, a Indonésia se torna uma nova potência, mas após um golpe de estado, o novo partido decide sacrificar o povo para lucrar com a exportação. Quando tudo parece perdido, um grupo de ex soldados se reúne para impedir o genocídio - ou morrer tentando.

programme.title: URI - Forças Especiais
programme.desc: As forças especiais do exército indiano executam uma operação secreta, vingando a morte de companheiros do exército em sua base por um grupo terrorista.

programme.title: URI - Forças Especiais
programme.desc: As forças especiais do exército indiano executam uma operação secreta, vingando a morte de companheiros do exército em sua base por um grupo terrorista.

programme.title: Esquadrão Antissequestro
programme.desc: Gabriela (Gabriela Simoni), uma menina de onze anos, filha de um jogador de futebol, é sequestrada durante a Copa do Mundo por um grupo de terroristas.

programme.title: O Mito
programme.desc: No ano de 221 a.C, o primeiro imperador da China Qin Shihuang começou a construção de sua tumba real. No mausoléu, foram enterrados o imperador, centenas de milhares de pessoas que trabalharam na construção, um tesouro e, diz a lenda, o elixir da juventude. Nos dias de hoje, o arqueólogo Jack Jackie Chan e o cientista William Tony Leung Ka Fai encontram em Dasar, na Índia, uma antiga espada da dinastia Qin, e uma pedra mágica que desafia a força da gravidade. Os objetos podem leválos ao mítico mausoléu e conectar Jack e seus recorrentes sonhos a uma surpreendente vida passada.

programme.title: Bodyguard – Resgate de Risco
programme.desc: Um filme de ação moderno combinando o melhor dos gêneros do Kung-Fu e super-heróis. A história narra a dramática jornada de Wu- Lin após a morte de seu mestre em artes marciais. Depois de deixar sua cidade natal para procurar seu companheiro aprendiz Jiang Li, ele se torna o guarda-costas de Fei-Fei, a filha de Jian-Shan Li, o chefe da família mais rica da cidade. Em circunstâncias perigosas, ele descobre muitos segredos e ameaças de vida. Para proteger aqueles que ama, ele escolhe o caminho escuro e solitário de buscar vingança e decide tomar a lei em suas próprias mãos.

programme.title: O Último Herói
programme.desc: Quando jovem, Andrey Rodin fez parte de um programa secreto de treinamento de espiões. Vinte anos depois, ele vive em paz até que seu pai, um ex-agente do governo quem Andrey pensava já estar morto, pede ajuda, o levando a aceitar uma missão que pode ser mortal.

programme.title: Entre Inimigos
programme.desc: No início da II Guerra Mundial, um confronto hostil nos céus da árida floresta norueguesa deixa duas aeronaves – uma britânica e uma alemã – caídas em uma região remota e isolada. Por uma estranha coincidência os grupos procuram abrigo na mesma cabana. Eles têm que lutar para sobreviver ao brutal inverno, para poder voltar à guerra

programme.title: El Guardaespaldas 2
programme.desc: Após ser libertado da prisão, um criminoso do sul de Londres tenta esquecer seu passado e mudar de vida; ele então se torna o protetor de uma jovem atriz que enfrenta alguns problemas.

programme.title: A Sonata Maldita
programme.desc: Após a morte repentina de seu pai, um compositor famoso, a talentosa violinista Rose herda a velha mansão que ele morou. Lá, ela descobre a obra final dele: uma trilha sonora misteriosa marcada com símbolos estranhos. Com a ajuda de Charles, seu agente, ela decifra os símbolos e, aos poucos, começa a desvendar segredos sobre o passado de seu pai, acionando os mecanismos de um plano sombrio imaginado desde o dia que ela nasceu.

programme.title: Fúria
programme.desc: A tranquila Rose trabalha com roupas de moda feminina, na esperança de ser designer. Um acidente de trânsito danifica seu rosto. Ela recebe tratamento experimental com células-tronco, deixando-a mais forte e mais bonita do que nunca, mas há um efeito colateral.

programme.title: A Casa da Morte
programme.desc: Um grupo de limpeza de cenas de crime luta para escapar de uma casa em que um brutal assassinato aconteceu, depois de ficarem presos ali por um antigo demônio nórdico que está determinado a deixálos loucos.

programme.title: Através das Sombras
programme.desc: Um homem rico contrata a professora Laura para educar seus dois sobrinhos órfãos, herdeiros de uma fazenda de café. Mas, aos poucos, Laura testemunha estranhos acontecimentos, que só se intensificam.

programme.title: A Aranha Negra
programme.desc: A jovem e corajosa parteira Christine faz um pacto com o diabo para salvar sua aldeia do terror brutal dos Cavaleiros Teutônicos. Mas quando a vila é devastada pela praga da aranha, ela se torna o bode expiatório e, portanto, a caça. Christine vai enfrentar a batalha decisiva contra o poder diabólico que quer tirar o maior bem pelo qual está disposta a morrer: a humanidade.

programme.title: Sentimentos Mortais
programme.desc: Seth e Jonah são gêmeos com uma habilidade perigosa: telecinese. As coisas saem do controle quando seus colegas de classe morrem um a um. Mas o ciúme logo os divide e eles não conseguem mais confiar um no outro, o que leva a uma batalha interna.

programme.title: O Segredo da Floresta
programme.desc: Durante uma viagem romântica no interior da Índia, um casal de Los Angeles acidentalmente testemunha o exorcismo assustador de uma menina de 11 anos. Eles decidem resgatá-la.

programme.title: O Grande tsunami
programme.desc: Um tsunami irrompe repentinamente, prendendo Jiang Peng e sua filha Jiang Xiao Hu, na Chinatown de um país do sudeste asiático. Os dois, juntamente com outros moradores, preparam-se para enfrentar a calamidade que se aproxima. No entanto, depois de superar o desastre natural, eles precisam enfrentar outra batalha de vida ou morte: um crocodilo gigante e monstruoso

programme.title: Festival Sangrento
programme.desc: Fãs se reúnem para um festival que celebra os filmes de terror mais famosos, mas à medida que os participantes começam a morrer, três adolescentes que sabem tudo sobre o tema devem se unir e combater todos os loucos, monstruosos e terríveis cenários para sobreviver.

programme.title: Navio De Sangue
programme.desc: Em algum lugar do Atlântico Norte, no fim de 1945, um bote salva-vidas à deriva carrega os sobreviventes de um navio-hospital torpedeado. Sem comida, água ou abrigo, tudo parece perdido, até que um caça-minas alemão abandonado se aproxima de forma ameaçadora, oferecendo-lhes uma última chance de sobrevivência.

programme.title: O Massacre da Família Manson
programme.desc: Nesta abordagem única sobre os infames assassinatos de Manson, seguimos duas gerações de eventos reais assustadores que ocorrem no 10050 Cielo Drive, um dos endereços mais notórios dos Estados Unidos.

programme.title: A Maldição De Raven's Hollow
programme.desc: Outono de 1830. Cinco cadetes da Academia Militar Americana de West Point incluindo Edgar Allan Poe participam de um treinamento no interior do estado de Nova York. Quando o grupo se depara com um homem estripado vestido de espantalho, um mistério assustador se inicia. A investigação deste terrível crime começa na vila vizinha de Raven's Hollow. Mas quando o primeiro imediato de Poe é assassinado, os cadetes se vêem ameaçados.

programme.title: O Homem Da Cabana
programme.desc: Com Stephen Lang, de "Avatar" e "O Homem das Trevas". Nas profundezas da floresta, um caminhante perdido encontra a cabana de um velho errático e recluso. O que começa como uma conversa cordial logo se torna um perigo quando fica claro que um ou ambos podem estar escondendo um segredo aterrorizante.

programme.title: Jogo Macabro
programme.desc: Un grupo de surfistas encuentra un antiguo tablero de juego de la Inquisición española llamado "Mamba". Al jugar, desatan una maldición mortal donde los perdedores mueren de formas macabras, convirtiendo su diversión en una lucha por sobrevivir.

programme.title: Siembamba: A Canção Do Mal
programme.desc: O choro incessante do seu bebê, sentimentos crescentes de culpa e paranoia levam Chloe a uma depressão sombria. Desorientada, ela visita o psicólogo, Dr. Timothy Reed, que diagnostica seus pensamentos e sentimentos como depressão pós-parto. O mundo ao seu redor implode e fica claro que ela e seu filho estão em perigo iminente. Mas de quê?

programme.title: O Alvo: Bem-vindo ao Inferno
programme.desc: Un equipo de mercenarios bajo las órdenes de Mack, un duro veterano de guerra, es contratado por una misteriosa agente de la CIA llamada Elissa para rescatar a un científico que está trabajando en un descubrimiento arqueológico en el desierto del oriente medio.

programme.title: Married...With Children

programme.title: Married...With Children

programme.title: Married...With Children

programme.title: Married...With Children

programme.title: Married...With Children
programme.desc: Al und Steves Campingurlaub wird von weiblichen Hormonen und menschenfressenden Tieren ruiniert.

programme.title: Married...With Children

programme.title: Married...With Children

Doch dann kommen er und Steve auf die Idee, den Rummel zu nutzen und blaue Wildlederschuhe zu verkaufen. Sie decken sich mit 700 Paar Blue Suede Shoes ein. Als sie damit nach Hause kommen, liegt alles verlassen da: In der Zwischenzeit war Elvis nämlich in einem Haushaltswarenladen in Ohio gesichtet worden ...

programme.title: Married...With Children
programme.desc: Kelly ist verzweifelt: Da hat sie ihren Mitschüler Matt angemacht, und der Typ reagiert überhaupt nicht. Das ist Kelly einfach nicht gewohnt. programme.title: Married...With Children

programme.desc: Für ihre Party haben Steve und Marcy die Wahrsagerin Olga engagiert. Während sich Marcy weigert, sich ihre Zukunft vorhersagen zu lassen, ist Peggy sofort dazu bereit: Madam Olga prophezeit nicht nur ihr einen Gewinn, sondern sogar Al wird Glück beschieden. Nun läßt sich Marcy doch hinreißen. Olga zögert - als würde sie etwas Schreckliches sehen. Doch die Wahrsagerin läßt sich darüber nicht aus. Als wenig später Marcy ihren Chef auf einen Geschäftsflug begleiten muß, besteht sie darauf, daß die Glückspilze sie begleiten - als Versicherung sozusagen ...

programme.title: Married...With Children
programme.desc: Al ist verzweifelt: Sein Friseur Tony ist gestorben. Niemand konnte das Haar so schneiden wie Tony. Al weigert sich standhaft, einen dieser modischen 'Hairstylisten' aufzusuchen. Zwei Monate hält er durch, dann ist das Haar einfach zu lang - vor allem das in der Nase. Also begibt er sich notgedrungen zu einem neuen Frisurenkünstler. Das Ergebnis ist niederschmetternd ...

programme.title: Married...With Children
programme.desc: Peggys Onkel Henry ist gestorben und hat den Bundys eine kleine Erbschaft hinterlassen. Selbstverständlich kann sich die Familie nicht einigen, wofür sie die 237 Dollar ausgeben wollen. Da macht Marcy den entscheidenden Vorschlag: Die Bundys sollten miteinander schön essen gehen. Gesagt, getan. Die Familie sucht ein vornehmes Lokal auf - oder besser gesagt: Sie sucht es heim. Und weil sie das Geld vergessen haben, müssen sie auch noch die Zeche prellen ...

programme.title: Married...With Children
programme.desc: Marcy ermutigt Peggy, am 'Career Day' der Schule teilzunehmen. Sie soll den Schülerinnen beibringen, wie man eine gute Hausfrau wird. Peggy wird die Sensation: Sie bringt ihren Zuhörerinnen bei, wie man Ehemännern die Brieftaschen mopst, wie man Fertigmenüs bestellt und das Allerwichtigste: Wie man die Kontrolle über die Fernbedienung behält...

programme.title: Married...With Children
programme.desc: Zu den Traditionen der Bundys gehört es seit jeher: Es wird niemals Gemüse gegessen und niemals gesteppt. Und nun trifft es ausgerechnet Kelly: Die Schulleiterin hat ihr ein Ultimatum gestellt. Entweder tritt sie der Stepptanzgruppe der Schule bei - oder sie fliegt von der Penne. Peggy und Al unternehmen alles, um Kelly vor dieser Schande zu bewahren. Peggy meint sogar, von der Schule zu fliegen sei besser. Doch dann legt Kelly in einem atemberaubenden Kostüm eine Nummer hin - aus Dirty Dancing ...

programme.title: Married...With Children
programme.sub-title: A Three Job, No Income Family
programme.desc: Es ist soweit: Peggy hat tatsächlich in einem Lebensmittelladen eingekauft. Danach wird ihr schlagartig klar, dass ein Einkommen für die Familie einfach nicht reicht. Sie entschließt sich, in einer Kosmetikfirma einen Job anzunehmen. Auf Verkaufsparties soll sie das Zeugs verscherbeln. Und es funktioniert. Bald verdient Peggy mehr als Al. Um seine Ehre als Ernährer der Familie zu retten, nimmt Al einen zweiten Job an. Aber auch damit kann er Peggy einkommensmäßig nicht schlagen. Doch dann kommt er dahinter, dass Peggy selbst ihre Kosmetika kauft ...

programme.title: Married...With Children
programme.desc: Peggy ist mit Steve im Wagen unterwegs. Steve bekommt panische Angst, dass ihm der Fahrer etwas antun könnte ...

programme.title: Married...With Children
programme.desc: Steve und Marcy wollen übers Wochenende wegfahren und bitten die Bundys, auf ihr Haus aufzupassen. Das hätten sie lieber nicht tun sollen. Kaum sind die Nachbarn weg, fallen Peggy und Al über das Haus her. Als Steve und Marcy zurückkommen, ist ihr Haus verschwunden. Wie sich herausstellt, wurde es aus Versehen abtransportiert. Wohl oder übel müssen die Bundys ihre Nachbarn für eine Nacht bei sich aufnehmen ...

programme.title: Married...With Children
programme.desc: Peggy und Al sind zu einem Klassentreffen eingeladen. Für Peggy ergibt sich daraus die schwierige Frage: Soll sie die Kinder ernähren oder ein Kleid für 500 Dollar kaufen? Schließlich war er schuld, dass sie damals nicht zur Ballkönigin gekrönt wurde - weil er sie nicht zum Abschlussball geführt hat. Das muss jetzt auf alle Fälle nachgeholt werden ...

programme.title: Married...With Children
programme.desc: Bald hat Peggy Geburtstag. Sie sähe es gern, wenn Al diesmal wenigstens etwas Geld für ein Geschenk ausgeben würde. Leider muß sie bei einem Einkaufsbummel feststellen, daß ihr Lieblingsbüstenhaltermodell nicht mehr produziert wird. Sie berichtet Al von ihrer Verzweiflung, und der versteht zunächst nur Bahnhof. programme.desc: Autumn claims her ex-boyfriend, D’Andre, abused her, which he denies. Why does she defend him to her parents?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The conversation continues with D’Andre, who blames his abusive relationship with his ex-girlfriend, Autumn, on her upbringing.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Recently, parents across America were googling “Who is Andrew Tate?” making him number three in Google searches for 2022, right behind Queen Elizabeth and Donald Trump. Tate claims to be helping young men acquire lots of money, drive luxury cars, and pick up hot women. However, in August 2022, Tate was banned on social media for his misogynist viewpoints. Twenty-four-year-old Ben says when he was a teen, he had zero self-esteem, never got past the first date, and felt powerless with girls. He tells Dr. Phil that men like Tate inspired him to break out of his shell -- and he shares how. Then, a healthy debate about “toxic masculinity” with the “Godfather of the Manosphere," a scholar and author, a men’s rights attorney, and the CEO and founder of the Center for Countering Digital Hate.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Andrew Tate is known for his misogynistic social media posts and videos claiming to be helping young men acquire lots of money, drive luxury cars, and pick up hot women. Tate is fighting a legal battle in Romania right now, but should parents worry about his influence on their sons? Before Tate was detained, Dr. Phil spoke with Richard Reeves, senior fellow at the Brookings Institute and author “Of Boys and Men: Why the Modern Male is Struggling, Why it Matters, and What to Do about It”; Marilyn York, a men’s rights attorney; Imran Ahmed, CEO and founder of the Center for Countering Digital Hate; and blogger and author Rollo Tomassi. Plus, hear from a group of teenage boys who surprise their mothers when they share what they think about Tate. And, Robin joins the conversation.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: My Dad Was The Breast Pump Bandit (Part 1)
programme.desc: Lauren says she resents her parents, Laura and John, claiming that as a teen, Laura stole her identity and racked up $50,000 in debt – a claim Laura denies – and that John had affairs on her mom and drank alcohol and used drugs with her and her teenage friends. John admits he was the “party dad,” but claims he was just trying to bond with Lauren. But is this just the tip of the iceberg? Dr. Phil drops the bombshell that John spent nearly two years behind bars and was dubbed the “Breast Pump Bandit” by his city’s local news. It’s a Dr. Phil episode you cannot miss!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In part one, amid claims of drinking and doing drugs with teenagers and extramarital affairs, Dr. Phil revealed that Lauren’s father, John, had been dubbed the “Breast Pump Bandit” by his city’s local news, for stealing thousands of dollars’ worth of breast pumps and selling them online --and admitted to taking Lauren on some of his shoplifting heists. Today, John admits that he’s addicted to Xanax and crack cocaine, and to stealing from Lauren’s mother to support his habit. Lauren says she wants her mom to kick him out of their lives once and for all. How does Laura respond? It’s a shocking conclusion you don’t want to miss!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Nicky, 17, says she loves to fight and proudly posts the videos of the brawls on the Internet. The teen brags that she once cracked a girl’s head on the concrete, has broken cheekbones and noses, and has had so many confrontations, she's lost count. She says the police have been called to her home as many as 80 times, and she’s been arrested monthly since she was 13 years old. What’s at the root of her rage? Dr. Phil delves deep into Nicky’s past to find the source of her pain. And, Nicky’s mom, Yvette, says she feels helpless and fears her daughter will end up dead or in prison, but is she modeling bad behavior? An anonymous letter to the show makes shocking allegations against Yvette. Can Dr. Phil get this family help -- before someone gets really hurt -- or worse?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Levi and Bob say their once-perfect, honor roll student, Tiffani, has changed into someone they don’t know, and she is terrorizing the family. Levi says the 15-year-old is mean and evil, drinks, steals and fights with her every day. In one altercation, Levi says Tiffani spit in her face, punched her and threatened to push her off a balcony, and now she’s afraid for her life. Bob says Tiffani doesn’t respect discipline or any authority -- including the police. Tiffani has been in juvenile detention three times, and Bob says each time she's released, her behavior only escalates. Dr. Phil takes a look into their family dynamics. How might Bob and Levi be contributing to Tiffani's recklessness? Plus, hear from Tiffani. You may be surprised to hear why she says she acts out.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Wake-Up Call for the Nation Pt 1
programme.desc: As the nation reels from the intense pressure of the 2020 Election, Dr. Phil welcomes broadcaster, journalist, and author Piers Morgan, whose latest book, Wake Up, is all about our divided society in the wake of COVID-19, the BLM protests, and the controversy surrounding the presidential election. Watch while Morgan reveals details of a 25-minute phone conversation he had with Donald Trump -- their first communication in months after he unfollowed Morgan on Twitter earlier this year. Dr. Phil and Morgan take a look at some of the most shocking stories of celebrities who have been "cancelled" in 2020, as well as some of the most tone-deaf mistakes made by the rich and famous. Also, how does Morgan keep his emotional and mental health in check during these trying times? Tune in to find out!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil investigates what he believes is a problematic phenomenon in our society: Cancel Culture: the way a large group of people can turn on and seek to dismantle the character, career, and sometimes life, of a person who says or does something that doesn't align with the group world view. Dr. Phil welcomes DailyMail.com editor-at-large Piers Morgan, whose new book Wake Up examines this very topic. Dr. Phil also invites Antifa member Daryle, and housewife turned activist Gina, who believes cancel culture is sometimes the only way to bring bigoted people to justice. Watch while Dr. Phil weighs in on this fierce debate!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Parents seek Dr. Phil's help for an out-of-control teen.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Parents say their out-of-contol teen daughter is corrupting her younger sister.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Families fight – that’s a fact of life. For most, tempers flare, you make up and life goes on. For sisters Maggie and Marsha however, they haven’t spoken in two years, and the rift has their family trapped in the middle. See their emotional reunion as another sister caught in the crossfire brings the matter before Dr. Phil. Also on the show...they seem like the all-American family, but these two sisters feel their once solid family bond is a distant memory. Join one of them as she confesses to her parents her true feelings, and hear how she suppressed a devastating secret for years. Tune in as Dr. Phil gives them the tools to bridge their emotional divide.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Where there’s a will, there’s a war! Jay says he was betrayed and ripped off by his sister Carole. She says her brother owes her money from their father's estate. She wants him to pay up. But is their family feud really about the money? After more than three years without speaking to each other, the gloves come off! Then, Christy borrowed $100,000 from her mother but refuses to pay the money back until her mother kicks out the convicted sex offender she’s been living with.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Six months ago, Ed revealed to his wife of 12 years that he'd been having an affair. That news was shocking enough, but shortly after he dropped another bombshell: The mistress is pregnant.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: After 12 years of marriage, Ed revealed to Kandi that he'd been having an affair and his mistress is now pregnant. Dr. Phil continues his in-depth look at the anatomy of an affair.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: A Family At War: The Intervention (Pt. 1)
programme.desc: This Dr. Phil Family is angry, out of control, and about to get an intervention in The Dr. Phil House. Melissa, 22, wrote to Dr. Phil for help for her self-destructive family. Her mother, Myra, and her stepfather, Gene, have a long history of betrayals, infidelity, anger and years of bitter resentment. Melissa says her family even turns special occasions into volatile disasters with turkey dinners and Christmas trees being thrown across the room. The fighting got so bad, Melissa says she had to move away from her extreme family. Her brothers, Edwin, 20, and Eugene, 17, attest that their home is a war zone, and that they have witnessed fights between their parents that involve name-calling, spitting and dousing each other with water, all in front of their 7-year-old brother. Myra says she can’t forgive Gene for his four affairs, but especially the last one, which was with a 19-year-old. Over three years have passed since Gene’s last affair, but Myra still calls him a pedophile every chance she gets, and says she’d leave if it weren’t for their youngest child. Can this family learn to stop the drama, heal their anger and start over with a healthy foundation, or should they call it quits for good?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his work with The Dr. Phil Family. Gene and Myra’s marriage has become a war zone, with ugly fights involving name-calling, spitting and throwing objects. Their children were caught in the middle and wrote to Dr. Phil for a family intervention. To find out if their broken marriage has a chance and to heal the resentment between all the family members, they move into The Dr. Phil House. First, Dr. Phil arranges for Myra to meet Lee, a pregnant self-proclaimed mistress in a long-term relationship with a married man. Will hearing another perspective help Myra let go of her anger and bitterness over Gene’s adulterous past? Next, since Gene admits he treats women like sexual objects, Dr. Phil wants to set him straight. Three successful women arrive at the house, determined to change Gene’s views about the opposite sex. After listening to them speak, Gene breaks down and says he wants to become a better husband. But do the ladies think he’s sincere? Gene and Myra’s three adult children, Melissa, Edwin and Eugene, join them in the house. After trying to have secret conversations off camera, Melissa gets a wake-up call when Dr. Phil knocks on the door. Then, in an exercise designed to get to the root of their resentments for each other, each family member takes a turn in the “hot seat” while the others open up about what they hate about them. Guess which person can’t take the criticism and wants to leave?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his work with The Dr. Phil Family, an out-of-control, angry group with a long history of infidelities, betrayals and bitter resentments. Melissa’s boyfriend, Randy, joins the family at The Dr. Phil House, but Gene and Myra are not happy to see him. They think that Randy is a liar and a thief, and the reason Melissa has gained about 100 pounds in the last five years. Gene and Myra attempt to talk to Melissa about her weight, but Melissa is anything but receptive. Then, because they often blame each other for the chaos in the family, Melissa and Gene are assigned to bury the hatchet long enough to cook a family dinner together, without help from anyone else. Will these relatives be able to follow the rules? After dinner, a family meeting turns heated with accusations and tearful confessions. Dr. Phil joins the family and confronts Melissa and Randy about their sometimes violent relationship and Melissa’s mismanagement of her health. Can this couple create a nurturing relationship for the sake of their autistic child? Will Melissa do what it takes to gain control over her weight?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: After all their hard work, the latest Dr. Phil Family receives some surprises from Dr. Phil! He informs Melissa that everything she needs to get her life back on track is headed her way: a complete health evaluation, personal trainer, nutritionist, and food service delivered to her door. In addition, she’ll receive help for her depression and be connected with a developmental disabilities specialist for her autistic son. But it all comes with a condition: Melissa and Randy need to heal their toxic relationship. Then, a talk with Myra and Gene leads to a tearful apology. And, will a one-on-one with Dr. Phil’s wife, Robin, help Myra see that she deserves to be treated with dignity and respect? Will Myra set some standards in her broken marriage? Will there even be a marriage to speak of when they get home? Dr. Phil has some strong words for Gene. Next, a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity pits brother against brother as Edwin and Eugene audition for a Hollywood talent agent and a casting director. Don’t miss the surprising twist when they get a call from the judges. Then, it’s time to switch gears – literally! Since Myra and Melissa never learned to drive, Dr. Phil sets them up with a driving lesson so they can become more independent. And you won’t believe the prize in store for the women if they pass their driver’s test! Dr. Phil sits down with the entire family one last time. Will they use the tools he gave them to build healthier relationships?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Do you think about everything you eat with the fear of gaining weight? Do you skip meals to lose weight? What about your teenager? Dr. Phil takes an eye-opening journey into the mind of an anorexic and bulimic. Meagan is 26 and weighs only 73 pounds. She starves herself all day, abuses laxatives, and binges and purges at night when everyone is asleep. She's been battling her eating disorders for over 10 years. Her parents, Donna and Tom, fear she could die at any moment and admit they enable Meagan’s disease to keep the peace. Meagan’s sister, Erika, says she’s so disgusted with her sister, she can’t stand being in the same room with her. When one member of the family has an eating disorder, it can make the entire family dysfunctional. Will Meagan accept help, and will her family do the work necessary to support her? Do you know the warning signs of someone who is at risk of developing an eating disorder? Parents, you can’t afford to miss this show!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his discussion with Meagan and her family. Meagan is a 26-year-old anorexic and bulimic who weighs only 73 pounds. She rules her house with her eating disorders, and her family is saying enough is enough. Will she give up control and accept help before it’s too late? And, get an update on Jennifer’s family. Three months ago, they sought Dr. Phil’s help for their daughter, who was battling anorexia and bulimia. How is Jennifer doing now? Her parents, Sue and Allan, and sister, Abbey, share with Meagan’s family what they’ve learned while Jennifer has been in treatment and how they can take their lives back and stop enabling the disease. Plus, test your knowledge of eating disorders. Would you recognize the warning signs?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: My Dad Was The Breast Pump Bandit (Part 1)
programme.desc: Lauren says she resents her parents, Laura and John, claiming that as a teen, Laura stole her identity and racked up $50,000 in debt – a claim Laura denies – and that John had affairs on her mom and drank alcohol and used drugs with her and her teenage friends. John admits he was the “party dad,” but claims he was just trying to bond with Lauren. But is this just the tip of the iceberg? Dr. Phil drops the bombshell that John spent nearly two years behind bars and was dubbed the “Breast Pump Bandit” by his city’s local news. It’s a Dr. Phil episode you cannot miss!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In part one, amid claims of drinking and doing drugs with teenagers and extramarital affairs, Dr. Phil revealed that Lauren’s father, John, had been dubbed the “Breast Pump Bandit” by his city’s local news, for stealing thousands of dollars’ worth of breast pumps and selling them online --and admitted to taking Lauren on some of his shoplifting heists. Today, John admits that he’s addicted to Xanax and crack cocaine, and to stealing from Lauren’s mother to support his habit. Lauren says she wants her mom to kick him out of their lives once and for all. How does Laura respond? It’s a shocking conclusion you don’t want to miss!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Doug and Debbie's once-perfect family has been shattered by the frightening reality that they could lose their 21-year-old son, Brandon, to drugs. Dr. Phil lays the groundwork for a successful intervention.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In an exclusive interview, Gabby Petito’s parents speak out all together for the first time since the 22-year-old “Van Life” vlogger's body was discovered in Grand Teton National Park in Wyoming. As the manhunt for her fiancé, Brian Laundrie, continues, they share their knowledge about his survival skills, and talk about the heartbreaking moment her stepfather had to identify Gabby. They also honor her life and memory, and discuss what they hope will be her legacy.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In part 2 of Dr. Phil’s exclusive interview with Gabby Petito’s parents, who are all sitting down together for the first time, they share where they believe Brian Laundrie may be hiding, and what they hope happens to him if he was involved in Gabby’s death. Plus, see their reaction to the latest developments in their daughter’s case.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: My Ex Puts Fame Before Our Daughter
programme.desc: A couple is battling for custody of their 10-year-old daughter.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Ex Falsely Accused Me of Poisoning
programme.desc: A heated custody battle discussion continues with accusations of abuse and sabotage.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Do you know people that can’t mind their own business? Dr. Phil’s first guest is fed up with her mother-in-law’s constant meddling in financial affairs, parenting, and even their intimate relations! So why does her husband frequently side with his parents? The friction mounts when members of this blended family speak out! Then, meet a 23-year-old woman who says her grandmother is smothering her. Can Dr. Phil help this dueling duo redefine their boundaries? Plus, find out how to deal with annoying backseat drivers before they drive you insane!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Everyone knows people that love to bicker. But what happens when the bickering escalates into verbal abuse and violence? Dr. Phil checks in with past guests Troy and Tammy whose explosive arguing is the primary dynamic in their marriage. Have they been able to break the cycle of drama or are they one step closer to divorce? Then—meet a single mother of five who worries that her children’s bickering may lead to fatal consequences! She thinks they’re out of control. So why is her daughter pointing the finger at her? Dr. Phil helps her end the fighting once and for all.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil revisits some of the most high-profile custody battles fought in the public eye. Model Bridget Marks is in the fight of her life after a court ordered her to turn her 4-year-old twin girls over to their father. Now, Dr. Phil gets her side of the story and what she plans to do next. And, when a mother decides she wants to move to Alaska with her kids, her ex-husband decides he’s going to fight her to the bitter end. Plus, a 12-year-old boy is caught between the grandmother who raised him and a mother desperate to reclaim him. Dr. Phil addresses the real casualties of these wars - the children - and talks about rules to live by when custody battles arise.

programme.desc: Dr. Phil shares advice for dealing with rude, crude and obnoxious behavior from your family members.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Every household has a relative who stirs the pot and creates conflict and havoc for the rest of the family. These troublemakers too often make holidays and family gatherings a living hell!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: On Thanksgiving Day 2013, the Hutson family’s celebration turned deadly when 19-year-old Rachel fatally shot her mother while her father was out shopping – and then texted her father a photo of her mother’s body. Rachel's lawyers say she had a history of mental illness that had gone undiagnosed for years. Did the added stress of caring for her ailing mother push her to snap? Or did she have a different motive? In an exclusive interview, will what caused her to commit this unthinkable crime finally be revealed? And, Rachel comes face-to-face with her family for the first time since she was sentenced.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Jacob’s son Blake was burned at 2 1/2 years old on a treadmill in his sister Ellen’s home at Thanksgiving in 2014. Jacob claims Ellen was 100% responsible for his son’s injuries and scars. Jacob’s wife, Beth, says that their family was uninvited to further Thanksgivings by Ellen. Ellen says that she never uninvited Jacob and his family, is not responsible for Blake’s injuries and says that in the four-and-a-half years Jacob has held this grudge, Blake hasn’t developed scars. Ellen and Jacob’s brother, Ed, says that he’s tried to play mediator, but after Jacob went on a social media rant in February 2019, rehashing the accident and continuing to blame Ellen, he knew that this unhealthy family feud needed bigger help. Can Dr. Phil help these siblings mend fences? Also- Pfizer’s Chief Patient Officer, Dr. Freda Lewis-Hall, discusses what Americans need to know about rheumatoid arthritis.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Mothers and their teenage daughters are rife for conflict under normal circumstances, but what happens when one party turns violent? Victoria wrote to Dr. Phil after she says her 18-year-old daughter, Jessica, physically attacked her on multiple occasions, leaving a gash in her head from a cellphone and her house damaged, as well as her body bruised after a Thanksgiving day family throw down. Victoria says she’s tried everything she can to help Jessica and she’s afraid her daughter is going to end up homeless, in jail, or dead without Dr. Phil’s help.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A desperate search for a missing 2-year-old boy in Texas, and a horrifying new discovery. Baby James’ family say they haven’t seen the toddler since Thanksgiving and claim his mother gave them a string of weak excuses when they asked where he was. In an exclusive interview, James’ great aunt says she feared something terrible had happened to the baby. She made a secret recording of her niece, the child’s mother, D’Lanny Chairez, who insisted that she placed her son for adoption. But James' great aunt says she wasn’t buying it, and when she went into D’Lanny’s home to search for James, she says what she found horrified her -- a terrible smell and a bloody blanket that police believe came from the baby’s crib. Was D’Lanny telling the truth about her son’s whereabouts? Don’t miss the shocking update.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Families fight – that’s a fact of life. For most, tempers flare, you make up and life goes on. For sisters Maggie and Marsha however, they haven’t spoken in two years, and the rift has their family trapped in the middle. See their emotional reunion as another sister caught in the crossfire brings the matter before Dr. Phil. Also on the show...they seem like the all-American family, but these two sisters feel their once solid family bond is a distant memory. Join one of them as she confesses to her parents her true feelings, and hear how she suppressed a devastating secret for years. Tune in as Dr. Phil gives them the tools to bridge their emotional divide.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Where there’s a will, there’s a war! Jay says he was betrayed and ripped off by his sister Carole. She says her brother owes her money from their father's estate. She wants him to pay up. But is their family feud really about the money? After more than three years without speaking to each other, the gloves come off! Then, Christy borrowed $100,000 from her mother but refuses to pay the money back until her mother kicks out the convicted sex offender she’s been living with.

programme.desc: Six months ago, Ed revealed to his wife of 12 years that he'd been having an affair. That news was shocking enough, but shortly after he dropped another bombshell: The mistress is pregnant.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Paul was his family’s rock and role model, so when he suddenly passed away, his wife and four children say their lives were shattered. Debbie, who was married to Paul for 30 years, says she shut down after his death and doesn’t know how to unite her brood. Sisters Jamie, Erica and Tayler say they don’t know how to properly grieve, they’re always fighting with each other, and they’re upset that their brother, Paul, turned his back on them. Paul says he didn’t run away from his loved ones; he has his own family and says he feels stretched thin. Find out the secret Erica’s been keeping that threatens to throw everyone into further turmoil, and hear the final wish Jamie’s dad had for her. If you’re grappling with grief after the loss of a relative, learn how to find closure and peace.

Ellen and Jacob’s brother, Ed, says that he’s tried to play mediator, but after Jacob went on a social media rant in February 2019, rehashing the accident and continuing to blame Ellen, he knew that this unhealthy family feud needed bigger help. Can Dr. Phil help these siblings mend fences? Also- Pfizer’s Chief Patient Officer, Dr. Freda Lewis-Hall, discusses what Americans need to know about rheumatoid arthritis.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Mothers and their teenage daughters are rife for conflict under normal circumstances, but what happens when one party turns violent? Victoria wrote to Dr. Phil after she says her 18-year-old daughter, Jessica, physically attacked her on multiple occasions, leaving a gash in her head from a cellphone and her house damaged, as well as her body bruised after a Thanksgiving day family throw down. Victoria says she’s tried everything she can to help Jessica and she’s afraid her daughter is going to end up homeless, in jail, or dead without Dr. Phil’s help.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A desperate search for a missing 2-year-old boy in Texas, and a horrifying new discovery. Baby James’ family say they haven’t seen the toddler since Thanksgiving and claim his mother gave them a string of weak excuses when they asked where he was. In an exclusive interview, James’ great aunt says she feared something terrible had happened to the baby. She made a secret recording of her niece, the child’s mother, D’Lanny Chairez, who insisted that she placed her son for adoption. But James' great aunt says she wasn’t buying it, and when she went into D’Lanny’s home to search for James, she says what she found horrified her -- a terrible smell and a bloody blanket that police believe came from the baby’s crib. Was D’Lanny telling the truth about her son’s whereabouts? Don’t miss the shocking update.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Shannon, 24, says two years ago, her ex-boyfriend stabbed her multiple times, and she feels betrayed by her mother, Dian, because she didn’t visit her in the hospital. Can they make peace with the past and fix their relationship? Plus, Kasey says she wants her 24-year-old son to stop living at home and playing video games all the time -- but is she part of the problem?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Do you think about everything you eat with the fear of gaining weight? Do you skip meals to lose weight? What about your teenager? Dr. Phil takes an eye-opening journey into the mind of an anorexic and bulimic. Meagan is 26 and weighs only 73 pounds. She starves herself all day, abuses laxatives, and binges and purges at night when everyone is asleep. She's been battling her eating disorders for over 10 years. Her parents, Donna and Tom, fear she could die at any moment and admit they enable Meagan’s disease to keep the peace. Meagan’s sister, Erika, says she’s so disgusted with her sister, she can’t stand being in the same room with her. When one member of the family has an eating disorder, it can make the entire family dysfunctional. Will Meagan accept help, and will her family do the work necessary to support her? Do you know the warning signs of someone who is at risk of developing an eating disorder? Parents, you can’t afford to miss this show!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his discussion with Meagan and her family. Meagan is a 26-year-old anorexic and bulimic who weighs only 73 pounds. She rules her house with her eating disorders, and her family is saying enough is enough. Will she give up control and accept help before it’s too late? And, get an update on Jennifer’s family. Three months ago, they sought Dr. Phil’s help for their daughter, who was battling anorexia and bulimia. How is Jennifer doing now? Her parents, Sue and Allan, and sister, Abbey, share with Meagan’s family what they’ve learned while Jennifer has been in treatment and how they can take their lives back and stop enabling the disease. Plus, test your knowledge of eating disorders. Would you recognize the warning signs?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Paul was his family’s rock and role model, so when he suddenly passed away, his wife and four children say their lives were shattered. Debbie, who was married to Paul for 30 years, says she shut down after his death and doesn’t know how to unite her brood. Sisters Jamie, Erica and Tayler say they don’t know how to properly grieve, they’re always fighting with each other, and they’re upset that their brother, Paul, turned his back on them. Paul says he didn’t run away from his loved ones; he has his own family and says he feels stretched thin. Find out the secret Erica’s been keeping that threatens to throw everyone into further turmoil, and hear the final wish Jamie’s dad had for her. If you’re grappling with grief after the loss of a relative, learn how to find closure and peace.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: If you're a parent having an extramarital affair " whether it's physical or emotional " should you tell your children? Or, if you're thinking about getting a divorce, how much should the kids know and when should they know it? Dr. Phil meets with a family torn apart over one parent's desire for a divorce.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Families fight – that’s a fact of life. For most, tempers flare, you make up and life goes on. For sisters Maggie and Marsha however, they haven’t spoken in two years, and the rift has their family trapped in the middle. See their emotional reunion as another sister caught in the crossfire brings the matter before Dr. Phil. Also on the show...they seem like the all-American family, but these two sisters feel their once solid family bond is a distant memory. Join one of them as she confesses to her parents her true feelings, and hear how she suppressed a devastating secret for years. Tune in as Dr. Phil gives them the tools to bridge their emotional divide.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Do you know people that can’t mind their own business? Dr. Phil’s first guest is fed up with her mother-in-law’s constant meddling in financial affairs, parenting, and even their intimate relations! So why does her husband frequently side with his parents? The friction mounts when members of this blended family speak out! Then, meet a 23-year-old woman who says her grandmother is smothering her. Can Dr. Phil help this dueling duo redefine their boundaries? Plus, find out how to deal with annoying backseat drivers before they drive you insane!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Everyone knows people that love to bicker. But what happens when the bickering escalates into verbal abuse and violence? She thinks they’re out of control. So why is her daughter pointing the finger at her? Dr. Phil helps her end the fighting once and for all.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil revisits some of the most high-profile custody battles fought in the public eye. And, when a mother decides she wants to move to Alaska with her kids, her ex-husband decides he’s going to fight her to the bitter end. Plus, a 12-year-old boy is caught between the grandmother who raised him and a mother desperate to reclaim him. Dr. Phil addresses the real casualties of these wars - the children - and talks about rules to live by when custody battles arise.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Where there’s a will, there’s a war! Jay says he was betrayed and ripped off by his sister Carole. She says her brother owes her money from their father's estate. Then, Christy borrowed $100,000 from her mother but refuses to pay the money back until her mother kicks out the convicted sex offender she’s been living with.

programme.title: Dr. Phil

programme.title: I Dream of Jeannie
programme.desc: Jeannie geht aus Mitleid für Roger zu einer Computer-Dating-Agentur, um ihm eine Freundin zu suchen. Gleichzeitig versucht Tony, Roger mit der Nichte des Generals zu verkuppeln.

programme.title: I Dream of Jeannie
programme.sub-title: Never Put A Genie On A Budget
programme.desc: Da Jeannie von Tony strenge Anweisung hat, den Haushalt ohne Zauberei zu führen, muß sie auch mit ihrem Haushaltsgeld auskommen - für einen Flaschengeist ein schier unmögliches Unterfangen. Als Tony sich über ihre Verschwendungssucht beschwert, schlägt Jeannie tatsächlich ab sofort einen eisernen Sparkurs ein.

programme.title: I Dream of Jeannie
programme.sub-title: Please Don't Give My Jeannie No More Wine
programme.desc: Jeannie und Tony sind bei den Bellows zum Abendessen eingeladen. Als Gastgeschenk bringen sie eine Flasche Wein mit, aber der ist ein ganz besonderes Tröpfchen: Jeannie hat ihn aus dem 16. Jahrhundert hergezaubert, und wer ihn trinkt, wird unsichtbar. So verschwinden Dr. Bellows und seine Frau, können sich selbst aber weiterhin sehen - ein äußerst kurzweiliger Abend bahnt sich da an ...

programme.title: I Dream of Jeannie
programme.sub-title: One Of Our Hotels Is Growing
programme.desc: Tony fährt mit seiner frisch angetrauten Gattin Jeannie nach Kalifornien. Mit von der Partie: Roger und die Bellows'. Bei ihrer Ankunft müssen sie leider feststellen, daß ihre Reservierung nicht angekommen ist.

programme.title: I Dream of Jeannie
programme.desc: Tony, Roger und Wingate müssen nach einer Mission drei Wochen in Quarantäne. Jeannie geht versehentlich durch das Glas der Isolationskammer und blinzelt sich in eine kleine goldene Figur.

programme.title: I Dream of Jeannie
programme.desc: In einer ihrer unbeschreiblichen Launen hat sich Jeannie zur Zerstreuung einen kleinen Zauberhund herbeigeblinzelt. Leider bringt der seine Gefährtin, Mrs. Djinn-Djinn, mit, und so gibt es bald ein paar Welpen.

programme.title: I Dream of Jeannie
programme.desc: Melvin, der kleine Neffe der Bellows, hält sich bei Tony und Jeannie auf und sieht dort, wie Jeannie in ihre Flasche verschwindet. Er nimmt die Flasche mit nach Hause, woraufhin Tony und Roger eine Rettungsmission starten.

programme.title: I Dream of Jeannie
programme.desc: Jeannie nimmt zum ersten Mal am Treffen der Offiziersgattinnen teil und wird Schriftführerin. Als sie von der anstehenden Wahl zum 'Ehemann des Jahres' erfährt, blinzelt sie Tony aus dem Simulator, aber der schläft tief und fest.

programme.title: I Dream of Jeannie
programme.desc: Tony ist Schuld, dass General Schaeffer ein wichtiges Billardspiel verliert, weil er im falschen Moment aufschreit. Als er dem General vor dem Rückspiel den Finger verletzt, muss er an seiner Stelle antreten - mit Jeannies Hilfe.

programme.title: I Dream of Jeannie
programme.desc: Bevor Tony endgültig in den Hafen der Ehe einläuft, soll noch eine große Junggesellenparty steigen. Das ist bei Jeannies sprichwörtlicher Eifersucht nicht leicht, aber mit Dr. Bellows' tatkräftiger Hilfe klappt es dann doch noch. Als bei der Party auch noch General Schaeffer mit einer Menge hoher NASA-Beamten erscheint, kocht die Stimmung erst richtig hoch.

programme.title: I Dream of Jeannie
programme.desc: Als entdeckt wird, dass Jeannie (wie sie glaubt) grüne und rote Blutkörperchen hat, rät Tony ihr, dass jemand anderer für sie den Bluttest für das Gesundheitszeugnis macht, damit die Hochzeitsvorbereitungen weitergehen können.

programme.title: Who's The Boss?
programme.desc: Kaum hat Tony seinen Abschluss gemacht und sich auf die Suche nach einem Lehrerjob begeben, wird ihm eine Traumstelle an einem entfernten College in Iowa angeboten. Nun stehen Tony und Angela vor ihrer bisher schwersten Entscheidung: was sie mit ihrer gemeinsamen Zukunft anfangen sollen.

programme.title: Who's The Boss?
programme.desc: Tony in Iowa und Angela in Connecticut bemühen sich tapfer, ihre Beziehung aufrecht zu erhalten, kommen aber bald zu der herzzerreißenden Erkenntnis, dass es einfach zu schwierig ist, eine Fernbeziehung zu führen.

programme.title: Who's The Boss?
programme.desc: Angela kehrt nur widerwillig in ihr Leben in Connecticut zurück, während Tony sein neues Leben in Iowa beginnt. Aber ihre Suche nach einer neuen Haushälterin nimmt ein überraschend glückliches Ende.

programme.title: Who's The Boss?
programme.desc: Ein ehemaliger Baseball-Spieler nimmt seine Tochter, seinen Stolz und seine Zukunft mit auf die Straße, um ein neues Leben zu beginnen, und lässt sich in der Vorstadt nieder, um den Haushalt einer ambitionierten Karrierefrau mit einem Sohn, der Schlangen liebt, und einer Mutter, die Männer liebt, zu führen.

programme.title: Who's The Boss?
programme.desc: Tonys peinlich saubere Haushaltsgewohnheiten erstrecken sich auch auf Angelas Gemächer. Aber er findet mehr als eine Gummiente, die in ihrer Badewanne schwimmt.

programme.title: Who's The Boss?
programme.desc: Tony wird von einem wohlmeinenden Amor zu einem intimen Abendessen mit seiner Chefin Angela überredet – mit unerwarteten Folgen.

programme.title: Who's The Boss?
programme.desc: Das Klassentreffen beschert Angela einen Überraschungsbesuch von ihrer alten Verbindungsschwester Trish, einer Rivalin, die sich noch immer an allem bedient, was ihr in den Kram passt, sei es Angelas Freund oder den aktuellen Haushälter.

programme.title: Who's The Boss?
programme.desc: Angela stößt sich an Tonys städtischen Erziehungsphilosophien, als die Faustkämpfe seiner Tochter auf ihren eigenen Sohn abfärben, nur um dann ihren Sohn und schließlich ihre Fassung zu verlieren.

programme.title: Who's The Boss?
programme.desc: Sowohl Angela als auch Tony machen es sich leicht, indem sie ihre falschen Identitäten behalten, um ihr Sozialleben zu verbessern.

programme.title: Who's The Boss?
programme.desc: Tony und Angela sind begeistert, dass Oma Mona, die gerade ein Studium begonnen hat, nicht nur Bücher von der Schule mitbringt – bis sie herausfinden, in welcher Klasse Monas neuer Verehrer ist.

programme.title: Who's The Boss?
programme.desc: Als Tony mit der Werbung für ein Produkt, das von Angelas Kunden vertrieben wird, berühmt werden will, müssen die beiden herausfinden, was sich durchsetzt: Geld oder Gewissen.

programme.title: Who's The Boss?
programme.desc: Ein verblüffter und unvorbereiteter Tony protestiert gegen die Aktionen von Angela, Mona und Mutter Natur, während seine burschikose Tochter Sam langsam zu einer Frau wird.

programme.title: Who's The Boss?
programme.desc: Als Angela sich in einen charmanten Anwalt verliebt, muss sie sich damit abfinden, dass der Hauptkonkurrent um ihre Aufmerksamkeit ihr „guter Kumpel“ und Sportfan Tony ist.

programme.title: Who's The Boss?
programme.desc: Tony stärkt Angelas Selbstvertrauen und ermutigt sie zu schnellem Handeln, als ein intriganter Chef den neuen Vorstandsvorsitzenden mit einer „Schmier“-Kampagne umgarnt.

programme.title: Who's The Boss?
programme.desc: Tonys Vertrautheit mit seinem Job führt zu Verachtung unter den Hausangestellten der Nachbarschaft und zu Unstimmigkeiten zwischen ihm und Angela.

programme.title: Who's The Boss?
programme.desc: Angela hilft Tony, mit der Erinnerung an seinen Vater umzugehen – und mit einer Wohnung, die mit Erinnerungsstücken seines Vaters gefüllt ist. Dadurch beschert sie Tony und Samantha ihr schönstes Weihnachtsfest überhaupt.

programme.desc: Tony wird von einem wohlmeinenden Amor zu einem intimen Abendessen mit seiner Chefin Angela überredet – mit unerwarteten Folgen.

programme.title: Who's The Boss?
programme.desc: Das Klassentreffen beschert Angela einen Überraschungsbesuch von ihrer alten Verbindungsschwester Trish, einer Rivalin, die sich noch immer an allem bedient, was ihr in den Kram passt, sei es Angelas Freund oder den aktuellen Haushälter.

programme.title: Who's The Boss?
programme.desc: Das Klassentreffen beschert Angela einen Überraschungsbesuch von ihrer alten Verbindungsschwester Trish, einer Rivalin, die sich noch immer an allem bedient, was ihr in den Kram passt, sei es Angelas Freund oder den aktuellen Haushälter.

programme.title: Who's The Boss?
programme.desc: Angela stößt sich an Tonys städtischen Erziehungsphilosophien, als die Faustkämpfe seiner Tochter auf ihren eigenen Sohn abfärben, nur um dann ihren Sohn und schließlich ihre Fassung zu verlieren.

programme.title: Who's The Boss?
programme.desc: Sowohl Angela als auch Tony machen es sich leicht, indem sie ihre falschen Identitäten behalten, um ihr Sozialleben zu verbessern.

programme.title: Who's The Boss?
programme.desc: Tony und Angela sind begeistert, dass Oma Mona, die gerade ein Studium begonnen hat, nicht nur Bücher von der Schule mitbringt – bis sie herausfinden, in welcher Klasse Monas neuer Verehrer ist.

programme.title: Who's The Boss?
programme.desc: Als Tony mit der Werbung für ein Produkt, das von Angelas Kunden vertrieben wird, berühmt werden will, müssen die beiden herausfinden, was sich durchsetzt: Geld oder Gewissen.

programme.title: Who's The Boss?
programme.desc: Ein verblüffter und unvorbereiteter Tony protestiert gegen die Aktionen von Angela, Mona und Mutter Natur, während seine burschikose Tochter Sam langsam zu einer Frau wird.

programme.title: Who's The Boss?
programme.desc: Als Angela sich in einen charmanten Anwalt verliebt, muss sie sich damit abfinden, dass der Hauptkonkurrent um ihre Aufmerksamkeit ihr „guter Kumpel“ und Sportfan Tony ist.

programme.title: Who's The Boss?
programme.desc: Tony stärkt Angelas Selbstvertrauen und ermutigt sie zu schnellem Handeln, als ein intriganter Chef den neuen Vorstandsvorsitzenden mit einer „Schmier“-Kampagne umgarnt.

programme.title: Who's The Boss?
programme.desc: Tonys Vertrautheit mit seinem Job führt zu Verachtung unter den Hausangestellten der Nachbarschaft und zu Unstimmigkeiten zwischen ihm und Angela.

programme.title: Who's The Boss?
programme.desc: Angela hilft Tony, mit der Erinnerung an seinen Vater umzugehen – und mit einer Wohnung, die mit Erinnerungsstücken seines Vaters gefüllt ist. Dadurch beschert sie Tony und Samantha ihr schönstes Weihnachtsfest überhaupt.

programme.title: Who's The Boss?
programme.desc: Kaum hat Tony seinen Abschluss gemacht und sich auf die Suche nach einem Lehrerjob begeben, wird ihm eine Traumstelle an einem entfernten College in Iowa angeboten. Nun stehen Tony und Angela vor ihrer bisher schwersten Entscheidung: was sie mit ihrer gemeinsamen Zukunft anfangen sollen.

programme.title: Who's The Boss?
programme.desc: Als Mona aus ihrer Wohnung geschmissen wird, versucht Tony, Einigkeit in der Familie herzustellen, indem er sie dazu bringt, bei Angela einzuziehen … wodurch er das Verhältnis aufs Äußerste strapaziert.

programme.title: Who's The Boss?
programme.desc: Als Angelas lange verschollener Abenteurer-Ehemann aus dem Dschungel zurückkehrt, lässt die aufflackernde Romanze Angelas Scheidungspläne verschwinden … genau wie Tonys Job.

programme.title: Who's The Boss?
programme.desc: Das romantische Glück zwischen Angela und ihrem entfremdeten Ehemann scheint sich abzukühlen und Tonys perfekter neuer Job lässt zu wünschen übrig – eine unerwartete Versöhnung könnte sich anbahnen.

programme.title: Who's The Boss?
programme.desc: Tony und Angela haben eine Menge zu erklären, als die Fernsehsendung „Eye on Hartford“ sie in einer kompromittierenden Position entdeckt.

programme.title: Who's The Boss?
programme.desc: Die zwölfjährige Samantha kann sich vielleicht nie wieder in der Schule blicken lassen, nachdem Tony sich freiwillig als Anstandswauwau bei ihrem ersten Schulball meldet und dann dabei erwischt wird, wie er ihre Lehrerin küsst.

programme.title: Who's The Boss?
programme.desc: Tony ist misstrauisch, was die Motive und Mittel seines Schwiegervaters angeht, als dieser urplötzlich vor Angelas Tür steht und Samantha mit teuren Geschenken überhäuft.

programme.title: Who's The Boss?
programme.desc: Angela macht sich Sorgen, dass die Geschichten, die Tony über seine Kindheitsstreiche erzählt hat, die Ursache für Jonathans seltsame Verhaltensänderungen sind.

programme.title: Who's The Boss?
programme.desc: Tony und Samantha müssen sich ihrer reichen Gemeinde auseinandersetzen, als Samantha verzweifelt einen Skiausflug machen will, den sich Tony nicht leisten kann. Regie: Asaad Keleda

programme.title: Who's The Boss?
programme.desc: Die romantische Verlockung droht die Beziehung zwischen Arbeitgeber und Arbeitnehmer zu zerstören, als Angela und Tony sich alleine wiederfinden, um Angelas Geburtstag zu „feiern“.

programme.title: Who's The Boss?
programme.desc: Samanthas verzweifelter Wunsch, zur beliebtesten Clique in ihrer neuen Junior High School zu gehören, bringt Tony in eine schwierige – und hochbezahlte – Position.

programme.title: Who's The Boss?
programme.desc: Tony nimmt Angela und die Kinder mit auf eine Pilgerfahrt nach Brooklyn zu Thanksgiving. Aber Angela zeigt sich wenig dankbar, als das Festessen eine große Portion männlichen Chauvinismus beinhaltet.

programme.title: Who's The Boss?
programme.desc: Tonys ehemaliger Schwiegervater, ein Knastbruder, macht sich nach seinem erfolglosen Antrag auf Bewährung aus dem Staub, als er erfährt, dass Samantha ihn enteignet hat.

programme.title: Who's The Boss?
programme.desc: Tonys Versuch, ein Date zwischen Angela und seinem kürzlich geschiedenen Kumpel zu arrangieren, führt zu einem regelrechten Wettkampf, als sich die quirlige Mona einmischt.

programme.title: Who's The Boss?
programme.sub-title: It Happened One Summer, Part I
programme.desc: Als sie den heimwehkranken Jonathan aus dem Sommercamp abholt, erinnert sich Angela wehmütig an ihre ersten romantischen Erlebnisse dort vor etwa 20 Jahren, stellt aber schockiert fest, dass es Tony gewesen sein könnte, mit dem sie eine kurze Begegnung am „Kussfelsen“ hatte.

programme.title: Who's The Boss?
programme.sub-title: It Happened One Summer, Part II
programme.desc: Tony und Angelas Begegnung im Sommercamp am „Kussfelsen“ als Teenager führt zu unerwarteten Reibungen, als ein plötzliches Gewitter sie wieder zusammenbringt – diesmal in einem abgelegenen Motelzimmer.

programme.title: Who's The Boss?
programme.desc: Mona freut sich über die Aussicht, ihr Erbe von einem mysteriösen Wohltäter zu verprassen – bis Tonys unschuldiger Fleiß Angelas schlimmste Vermutungen über den Philanthropen bestätigt.

programme.title: Who's The Boss?
